exploration_design.broad_sweep: Four selected Stage35 variants from RUN29B.
exploration_design.extreme_sweep: hold 6/12/24 bars plus OOS without 2025-10 and OOS half-window stress.
exploration_design.failure_memory: Candidate failure is preserved as a negative clue, not idea death.
exploration_design.hypothesis: The four RUN29B both-positive clues may differ by hold length and OOS time dependence.
exploration_design.micro_search_gate: Only candidates surviving base, no-October, and half-window checks should get a native or WFO packet.
exploration_design.tier_scope: Tier A runtime probe; Tier B and combined records are out_of_scope_by_claim.
exploration_design.wfo_plan: not WFO; this is a candidate stress runtime probe.

result_judgment.evidence_missing: native MT5 state assignment, WFO, Tier B/combined runtime rows, and runtime authority closure
result_judgment.next_condition: Only a separate narrow native/WFO packet can upgrade a surviving clue.
